shot_options.shot_word: In a single 4-second medium-wide shot, Lili anchors the tip of her massive segmented tail into a cyan docking socket on the wet foreground platform of the bone airport; the tail absorbs her weight, her small upper body snaps steady, red warning lights stop blinking, and the camera slowly pushes in along the giant rib arches.

Lili slides across the foreground platform of the bone airport, using the heavy tail as a low brake; the tail scrapes sparks and mist from the dark metal floor while cyan lamps trace the path and her red hair whips forward.
A low-angle shot under the giant ribs shows Lili looking up at a passing winged craft; her tail rises behind her like a second spine, balancing her body against the scale of the bone hangar.
Lili jumps down from a side platform and lands on the tail first, then her feet touch the floor; the tail bends, unfolds, and pushes her upright as gray-purple banners sway in the airport draft.

A close medium shot follows Lili grinning as a red warning beacon reflects across the red armor plates of her tail; she taps a cyan interface with one clawed tail tip and the beacon turns into a steady guide light.

Lili pivots around a suspended cargo crate, curling her tail around the platform edge to avoid a worker; the camera tracks sideways, keeping her red hair, small torso, and massive tail in one readable silhouette.

On a narrow bone bridge, Lili hooks her tail under a rib support and pulls herself across a gap; the bone structure flexes slightly, cyan maintenance lights flicker, and the action shows shared weight between body, tail, and bridge.

Lili releases the tail from a docking socket and turns back toward the camera; a pale cyan afterglow trails from the socket, her tail plates fold closed, and the bone airport continues moving behind her.

prompt_sections.detailed_description:
The target video uses a restrained hand-drawn mechanical-fantasy animation look with the P00 palette: deep ink-cyan dark structure, pale cyan-gray mist, gray-purple biological cloth accents, cyan interface light, and small dark-red warning accents.
[Shot 1] A single 4-second medium-wide shot begins on the wet foreground platform of <Subject 2>, the giant bone airport from <Picture 3>. Rib arches curve overhead into pale mist, small workers and hanging cargo remain in the background, and cyan navigation lamps glow along the platform edge. <Subject 1>, Lili from <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>, slides in from the left foreground with red hair whipping forward, her compact upper body leaning low and her huge segmented tail still connected to her lower body. The camera makes a slow low push-in along the platform, keeping Lili in the lower foreground and the rib arches readable behind her. Her tail lands first with visible weight, the dark gray segments compress, and red armor plates overlap as the tail bends. At about 00:01.200, the tail tip finds a cyan docking socket on the platform beside a short lamp post. At about 00:02.000, the tail tip plugs into the socket; cyan light travels from the socket into the tail's interface cores, while a nearby dark-red warning point stops blinking. Lili's feet skid for a half step, then her body snaps steady as the tail takes the load. At about 00:03.200, she lifts her chin with a sharp confident grin, hair and sleeve ends settling from the inertia, while the tail remains braced between her body and the platform. The final frame holds the connected tail, the glowing socket, and the bone airport depth in one clear silhouette.
prompt_sections.overall_soundscape: Cold airy airport room tone, distant wing beats, soft suspended-cargo creaks, wet platform foot-scrape, a heavy segmented tail scrape, and a short cyan interface hum when the tail plugs in.
